Garantiklinikken is a healthcare clinic in Denmark evaluated in the annual report of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark) for the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023 [^src1]. The clinic is included in the detailed hospital- and municipality-level analyses for clinical quality indicators managed by the Regional Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP) [^src1]. Specifically, it is noted as a clinic that meets the standard for Indicator 1 [^src1].

In the evaluation of [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who receive an echocardiography, Garantiklinikken performed exceptionally well. The clinic met the indicator for 98.5% (95% CI: 95.6–99.7) of its patients, successfully fulfilling the national standard [^src2]. 

However, the clinic's performance varied significantly across different metrics. For [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]], which measures the coverage of anticoagulation treatment two years after an atrial fibrillation diagnosis, Garantiklinikken did not meet the required standard. The clinic achieved a proportion of only 53.8% (95% CI: 43.1–64.4), falling far short of the ≥90% target and marking it as a notable outlier in the national healthcare system's quality improvement efforts [^src3]. The clinic was also evaluated in other indicators during the reporting period, showing mixed compliance results [^src4].
